finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 37 touch behavior.

Three breaking changes hide under `refactor` and `fix`. Seven commits `stop re-exporting the internal error types` from `core`, `db`, `auth`, `jobs`, `billing`. `refactor(api): drop the unused v1 export route` deletes a route. `fix(auth)` swaps 403 for 401 on an expired token.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff. Ten `perf` commits I left out. All dep bumps are patch or minor.

Next: confirm those error types were public. Four commits say `docs: note the minimum node version` and CI moved to node 22. Check if `engines` changed too.
